name: qr-scanner-thunderbird
description: Thunderbird extension that finds and decodes 2D codes (Data Matrix, QR, …) in displayed emails, locally and offline.

scripts.lint: eslint . && npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.package: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir dist --filename "qr-scanner-{version}.xpi" --overwrite-dest && tsx scripts/check-size.ts
